description: Paid. Reranks every coin TVR covers with your own weights for the 8 fundamental metrics, applying TVR's non-public score transformation. Returns rank, TVR Score, valuation category, fair value gap and TVR Estimated Value per coin. $0.05 per call, paid in-band with x402 (USDC on Base) or MPP (USDC.e on Tempo); an unpaid call returns the offer (isError with the x402 PaymentRequired in structuredContent) and charges nothing. Invalid input is refused before any payment. Free alternative: get_top_ranked and the four presets. Data from True Value Rankings (truevaluerankings.com).

coins.description: Optional tickers or names (1-50). Omit for all covered coins.

weights.description: Up to 8 weights (0-100) in this order: economic_model, network_security, adoption, privacy, longevity, liquidity, legal_clarity, technical_dev, or an object keyed by those names. Missing entries take TVR defaults.

name: get_custom_ranking

rankings.description: Ranked coins under the requested weights
